column1: v2 FIELD / INSTALLATION ENGINEERING REVIEW

Source-backed review checklist for site conditions that a spreadsheet cannot infer reliably. NEMA/NECA installation guidance, Eaton design guidance, Southwire installation practice, and NRC cable/fire operating experience all reinforce verifying the as-installed route, supports, environment, cable restraint, fire barriers and maintenance/modification controls.

column1: Single-conductor cables are fastened / cleated for the actual fault duty and formation
